summary:
Updated implementation plan:
- Illustrated and composited a classic vintage steam locomotive head into the start screen image.
- Feature details: enameled midnight navy boiler barrel, brass reinforcing straps, flanged chimney with rising moonlit steam, front circular boiler face with compass star emblem, glowing brass headlight lantern casting light on curved tracks, and front cowcatcher grill.
- Aligned dynamic steam particle emission and headlight track beam in React/Canvas.
